name: M5.CRT.safe_prime_residue
statement: ∀ p δ T e : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ δ → Nat.gcd (Nat.gcd T δ) e = 1 → ¬ p ∣ e + M5.CRT.repairResidue e p * T
guidance: Split on p | e. If false the residue is zero. If true residue is one; p | T would force p | gcd(gcd T δ)e = 1, contradicting primality. Exclude p | e+T by subtracting the known divisible summand. Includes p=2. Return tactic lines only, without a leading by. Preserve the exact target.
